\begin{frame}{Response-adaptive randomization}
  \begin{block}{Key idea}
    The next allocation probability can depend on earlier outcomes.
  \end{block}
  \[
    \Pr(T_{n+1}=1 \mid \mathcal F_n) = p_n.
  \]
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Blocks and columns}
  \begin{columns}[T,onlytextwidth]
    \begin{column}[T]{0.48\textwidth}
      \begin{alertblock}<1->{Caution}
        Adaptive probabilities must remain bounded away from zero.
      \end{alertblock}
    \end{column}
    \begin{column}[b]{0.48\textwidth}
      \begin{exampleblock}{Interpretation}
        Balance ethics with inferential precision.
      \end{exampleblock}
    \end{column}
  \end{columns}
\end{frame}
